save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state, epoch, and config to disk
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint with optional weight inflation and caffe2 conversion
load_train_checkpoint: load the latest or specified training checkpoint to resume training from a prior epoch
load_test_checkpoint: load a checkpoint for model evaluation from test config or last saved checkpoint
inflate_weight: inflate 2D convolution weights from a pretrained model to match 3D convolution dimensions
